_readme: Supersede-gate eval set. Each item: case_id groups all variants of one situation (split MUST keep a case_id whole, no train/holdout leak). label in {supersede,coexist,new}. origin in {real,synthetic}. For real items, new_id references an existing KB entry whose stored content is embedded as the incoming entry (excluded from its own results). For synthetic items, new_text/new_title/new_tags are the incoming entry. expect_related_ids = KB entry ids the gate SHOULD surface (supersede: must surface >=1 => stop is correct; coexist: surfacing => unnecessary stop-on-coexist; new: expect empty => any surfacing is stop-on-new). Real supersede require ZERO misses; synthetic holdout <=10%. Report real vs synthetic separately; synthetic passes must not mask a real miss.
